summary: Feature implemented by reading and editing only; nothing was run or committed. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), plus plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Rewired SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver (engine-accepting finalize wrapper for ignite 0.3.0), and TensorBoardImageHandler (new index parameter) as thin adapters. Changed write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. Renamed output_path to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py; passed filename in the classification handler test. Added tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Added savers to docs/source/data.rst. Not verified: tests, flake8, and examples were not run; line lengths were checked by search only. Choices to review: CSV keys are str() of filename_or_obj; NiftiSaver converts tensor affines to numpy; blank CSV lines are skipped on merge; segmentation default dtype is now None, so example outputs keep the model's dtype.
